message: The other day, I found myself happily organizing my storm supply kit while the kids were arguing over whose turn it was to pick a movie. I realized that I might be the gloriously over-prepared person in our family—I've got snacks, flashlights, and even a deck of cards in there. But hey, if the power goes out during a storm, at least I’ll be ready for a family game night. What's your go-to storm snack?
